input.summary:
Implemented parsed `anchorRange?: [number, number]` on the public node base type. Anchored scalar, sequence, map, and empty-value nodes now record zero-based UTF-16 `[start, end)` offsets covering the complete anchor token, independently of `keepSourceTokens`; aliases, unanchored nodes, and programmatically anchored nodes remain without an own property. `clone()` now copies the tuple separately, including collection clones. Changes are restricted to `src/compose/compose-node.ts`, `src/nodes/Node.ts`, and `src/nodes/Collection.ts`.
